<p>Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations.</p>
<p>Net sales increased 9% to $513,983 million in 2022. We recorded a net loss of $2,722 million, driven largely by a $12.7 billion pre-tax valuation loss on our Rivian common stock investment. We continued regionalization of our fulfillment network to shorten transportation distances and improve unit cost efficiency.</p>
<p>Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data.</p>

<p>Item 1A. Risk Factors. We face intense competition in e-commerce and cloud infrastructure services, and our expansion into new geographies exposes us to fluctuating foreign exchange rates.</p>
